stage: Synthetic conditional-anchor calibration; no real DIF
timing: After implementation and independent synthetic checks (including a two-repeat runner smoke test), before the full 500-repeat-per-scenario calibration. No changes based on interim calibration outcomes.
changes: Simulation cannot establish that any real item is DIF-free. Anchor sets below are oracle constraints in synthetic populations only, not ELSA anchor selection.
No data-driven anchor selection via non-significant real DIF. Any future discovery selection requires its own calibration and freeze before internal replication.
The 40% subset already contributed configural-fit information: call it internal replication, not untouched external confirmation.

Freeze explicit probit response-function parameters with residual variance 1, reference latent means 0 and variances 1. O1 means/variances free. Invariance of raw CFA residual/response scales is not separately identified.
Use a bounded representative scenario grid first. It does not complete the old full factorial grid or automatically authorize real DIF.
Family includes 8 two-sided slope/threshold contrasts among 4 nonanchors, with Holm correction; no testing the constrained anchors themselves.
model: M2 with Affect=i1,i4,i5,i6,i7, Somatic=i2,i3,i8. Anchors i1,i4,i2,i3 have equal probit slopes and thresholds across groups; all other slopes/thresholds free.

generator.interpretation: Rounded illustrative parameters informed by prior aggregate preflight; no individual ELSA data read. Not calibrated to reproduce every empirical joint probability or floor exactly.
generator.cluster_sizes: 1 or 2; mean household size about 1.27244; nine balanced artificial strata; household latent ICC 0.30; 25% individual group re-draw creates mixed households.
generator.weights: lognormal household weights with log SD 0.6, independent of responses and group; NOT a full ELSA selection/nonresponse weight model.

estimator: Two-group lavaan DWLS with explicit equality labels. Both variance methods use information.bread=expected. Compare ordinary robust.sem variance (does not account for household clustering) to independently checked stratified household sandwich. This explicitly overrides lavaan 0.7-3 default observed bread so that the comparison isolates moment/design covariance treatment.
covariance_verification: Household sandwich cannot be used until iid equal-weight comparison to lavaan robust.sem and cluster bootstrap checks have been documented. If unavailable or invalid, report ordinary variance as a diagnostic only and keep real DIF blocked. The implementation uses binary moment influence functions and a DWLS expected-information/Gauss-Newton derivative. Under model or anchor misspecification it is a diagnostic approximation, not a general misspecification-robust covariance proof; finite weights are treated as supplied constants.
reporting: Successes/failures, warnings, Monte Carlo standard error, Wilson 95% interval for binomial rates, slope/threshold bias and coverage, target power, 8-test Holm family-wise false positives. Report conditional-on-success and conservative failure-as-adverse rates.

numerical_gates.screen_interpretation: 0.08 is a predeclared exploratory tolerance for this 500-repeat screen, NOT a claim of proven 0.05 control.
numerical_gates.power_interpretation: Report whether the predeclared injected effect reaches 80% Holm-adjusted power. Low power prohibits conclusions of no DIF, not automatically every descriptive analysis.

bootstrap_check: On one fixed synthetic cluster_null population sample, 199 whole-household within-stratum bootstrap draws, duplicate each sampled household and preserve original case weights. Compare bootstrap SD with sandwich SE; gross-mismatch check is all ratios 0.75 to 1.33, set before viewing final bootstrap output. This alone is not coverage validation.
remaining_before_real_inference: Substantive justification of actual anchors and model-structure sensitivity (M1R).
Negative DIF, additional effect sizes, balanced group, both-factor and joint-anchor contamination, empirical weight informativeness and missingness stress scenarios from the broader plan.
Survey design applicability and independent estimation/inference audit.
